key_weather_variables: Leaf-wetness duration and temperature during wetness ; Previous five-day mean temperature ; Number of rainy days ; Minimum temperature ; Sunshine ; Accumulated temperature after heading
thresholds_text: Wetness requirements: 17 h at 15 C to 10 h at 22–25 C; previous five-day mean 20–25 C (Hiroshima BLASTAM). 20–25 C, at least three rainy days, RH at least 90%, and limited sunshine (RDA, Korea). Panicle infection: 0–300 degree-days after heading (Kobayashi et al., international). Sources: [Hiroshima BLASTAM Table 1](https://www.pref.hiroshima.lg.jp/uploaded/attachment/535771.pdf); [RDA 2023-06-15](https://rda.go.kr/board/board.do?mode=view&prgId=day_farmprmninfoEntry&dataNo=100000788240); [Kobayashi et al. 2010](https://www.jppa.or.jp/archive/pdf/64_02_01.pdf)
required_inputs: Heading date ; Transplanting date ; Region ; Cultivar
evidence_summary: Leaf window source-based; panicle infection window source-based; D-relative conversion inferred

key_weather_variables: Temperature ; Within-canopy RH ; Number of hot humid days
thresholds_text: 30–32 C and RH at least 96% (Korean). 28–32 C and canopy RH 85–100% (international). Sources: [RDA 2023-06-15](https://rda.go.kr/board/board.do?mode=view&prgId=day_farmprmninfoEntry&dataNo=100000788240); [IRRI](http://www.knowledgebank.irri.org/training/fact-sheets/pest-management/diseases/item/sheath-blight)
required_inputs: Transplanting date ; Nitrogen application and planting density

key_weather_variables: Leaf wetness ; Temperature ; Air humidity ; Weekly rainfall and cloudiness
thresholds_text: 8–24 h leaf wetness (IRRI). Optimal germination at 20–30 C; invasion humidity 70% at flowering and 90% at milk stage (NCPMS, Korea). Sources: [IRRI](http://www.knowledgebank.irri.org/training/fact-sheets/pest-management/diseases/item/brown-spot); [NCPMS](https://ncpms.rda.go.kr/npms/SicknsInfoDtlR.np?sicknsListNo=D00000750)
required_inputs: Heading date ; Soil: sandy or degraded paddy

key_weather_variables: July mean temperature and monthly rainfall ; Number of rainy days ; Wind speed and typhoons ; Duration of flooding
thresholds_text: July mean 22–24 C, July rainfall at least 200 mm, wind at least 15 m/s; flooding 12 h: 8.8%, 48 h: 72.7% (Korean). 25–34 C and RH above 70% (international). Sources: [NCPMS](https://ncpms.rda.go.kr/npms/SicknsInfoDtlR.np?sicknsListNo=D00000744); [EPPO](https://gd.eppo.int/taxon/XANTOR/datasheet)
required_inputs: Flooding and typhoon dates ; Flooding duration ; Region
evidence_summary: Event window inferred (close to source-based); monthly criterion source-based

key_weather_variables: Temperature ; Persistent rainfall ; Heavy rain and strong wind
thresholds_text: Progression at 26–32 C, suppressed below 22 C (international source). Sources: [EPPO XANTTO](https://gd.eppo.int/taxon/XANTTO/datasheet)
required_inputs: Heavy-rain and strong-wind dates ; Seed origin

key_weather_variables: Nursery temperature ; Flowering nights and light rain ; Sporulation temperature
thresholds_text: Nursery optimum 35 C, asymptomatic at 20 C, sporulation at 24–32 C (NCPMS, Korea). Sources: [NCPMS](https://ncpms.rda.go.kr/npms/SicknsInfoDtlR.np?sicknsListNo=D00000752)
required_inputs: Sowing date ; Nursery method ; Seed disinfection ; Seed origin
evidence_summary: Nursery criterion source-based; H+7 duration inferred

key_weather_variables: Rainy days during booting ; Sunshine ; Temperature
thresholds_text: Frequent rain around heading, about 25 C and limited sunshine (RDA 2024-08-01, Korea). Rainfall 14–10 days before heading (JA Zen-Noh Ibaraki, international). Sources: [RDA 2024-08-01](https://www.rda.go.kr/board/board.do?mode=view&prgId=day_farmprmninfoEntry&dataNo=100000797460); [JA Zen-Noh Ibaraki 2714](https://www.zennoh.or.jp/ib/contents/make/einou/2714.pdf)
required_inputs: Heading date ; Nitrogen application

key_weather_variables: Minimum and maximum temperature around heading ; Rainfall ; Wetness duration
thresholds_text: Minimum at least 24 C around heading (Gifu, international). Sustained temperatures at least 30 C or frequent rainfall around 30 mm (RDA 2015-07-29, Korea). Sources: [Gifu Prefecture](https://www.pref.gifu.lg.jp/uploaded/attachment/302902.pdf); [RDA 2015-07-29](https://korea.kr/news/pressReleaseView.do?newsId=156066598)
required_inputs: Heading/flowering date
evidence_summary: Core window source-based; H-3 and D-relative conversion inferred

scientific_name: Rice stripe virus, vector Laodelphax striatellus
key_weather_variables: Winter temperature ; Accumulated temperature from January 1 ; Southwesterly migration airflow ; Transmission temperature
thresholds_text: Transmission at 25–30 C, rare at or below 15 C (Jung 1974, Korea). Vector developmental thresholds 10.2/10.7 C (Park 2011, Korea). Sources: [Jung Bong-jo 1974](https://koreascience.or.kr/article/JAKO197425720625117.pub); [Park 2011](https://koreascience.or.kr/article/JAKO201106239853568.pub?lang=ko)
required_inputs: Transplanting date ; Leaf age ; Region: whether on the west coast
evidence_summary: Short-term inferred; January 1 accumulation and qualitative winter conditions source-based

scientific_name: Rice dwarf virus, vectors Nephotettix cincticeps and others
key_weather_variables: Vector accumulated temperature ; Winter temperature ; Autumn ratoon rice
thresholds_text: Vector development thresholds: eggs 14.3 C, nymphs 13.3 C; oviposition lower limit 16.9 C (Tochigi, Japan). Transmission temperature/humidity unconfirmed. Sources: [Tochigi Agricultural Research Report 26](https://www.agrinet.pref.tochigi.lg.jp/nousi/kenpou/kp_026/kp_026_05.pdf)
required_inputs: Transplanting date ; Presence of ratoon rice

key_weather_variables: Soil temperature and moisture
thresholds_text: Soil about 28 C and wet conditions (Vineeth 2025, international). Sources: [Vineeth 2025](https://www.uasbangalore.edu.in/wp-content/uploads/2025/09/37.pdf)
required_inputs: Seed and plant introduction history ; Sowing date

key_weather_variables: Floodwater level ; RH ; Temperature
thresholds_text: 27–30 C and RH at least 75% (international source). Sources: [USDA CAPS 2016](https://caps.ceris.purdue.edu/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/Ditylenchus-angustus-datasheet-2016.pdf)
required_inputs: Flooding onset date ; Water depth ; Seed introduction

key_weather_variables: Leaf wetness ; Dewy nights ; Temperature
thresholds_text: 18–27 C and 6 h leaf wetness; 14 h dew for sporulation (international sources). Sources: [CPN](https://cropprotectionnetwork.org/publications/an-overview-of-northern-corn-leaf-blight); [Levy & Cohen 1992](https://consensus.app/papers/details/8f2c95d6defa54869526ee51ca3be04b/)
required_inputs: Growth stage ; Continuous cropping and residue

key_weather_variables: Temperature ; Wetness
thresholds_text: Warm humid conditions at 20–30 C; disease develops in 60–72 h (Korean source). Sources: [Nongsaro](https://www.nongsaro.go.kr/portal/ps/pss/pssa/sicknsSearchDtl.ps?pageIndex=1&pageSize=10&sicknsCode=D00001196&menuId=PS00202)
required_inputs: Sowing date ; Residue

key_weather_variables: Hours at RH at least 90% ; Hours at 22–30 C ; Night temperature ; Residue
thresholds_text: RH at least 90% for over 12 h; cumulative V4–V12 exposure (international sources). Sources: [CPN](https://cropprotectionnetwork.org/encyclopedia/gray-leaf-spot-of-corn); [Paul & Munkvold 2005](https://consensus.app/papers/details/dcb59be91bc05466ae1123e573e83cb1/)
required_inputs: Sowing date ; Growth stage ; Residue cover
evidence_summary: Seasonal window source-based; D-relative window inferred

key_weather_variables: Leaf wetness ; Daytime and nighttime temperature ; RH ; Windborne introduction
thresholds_text: At least 3 h wetness; daytime 16–25 C, nighttime 18–21 C (Cornell, international). Sources: [Cornell](https://www.vegetables.cornell.edu/pest-management/disease-factsheets/common-rust-of-sweet-corn)
required_inputs: Nearby occurrence reports

key_weather_variables: Dew duration ; Night temperature ; Temperature
thresholds_text: Optimum 26 C and 16 h dew; lower limit 16–18 C (international). Korean isolates germinate best at 25 C, declining sharply above 32 C. Sources: [Hollier & King 1985](https://consensus.app/papers/details/44f387775075552bb3ee61c7006bea08/); [Lee 2025](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC12337728/)
required_inputs: Growth stage: after VT ; Nearby occurrence
evidence_summary: D-relative window inferred; weekly index source-based (China)

key_weather_variables: Temperature ; Rainfall following drought ; Hail and strong-wind wounds
thresholds_text: Early growth at 26–34 C with little rainfall (international). Incubation 7–21 days (Korean source). Sources: [Illinois RPD 203](http://ipm.illinois.edu/diseases/series200/rpd203/index.html); [Nongsaro](https://www.nongsaro.go.kr/portal/ps/pss/pssa/sicknsSearchDtl.ps?menuId=PS00202&sKidofcomdtyTabCode=FC&sKidofcomdtyCode=FC040401&sicknsCode=D00001177)
required_inputs: Silking date ; Hail and strong-wind dates
evidence_summary: Susceptibility window source-based; seven days before silking inferred

key_weather_variables: Soil temperature ; Soil moisture
thresholds_text: Infection possible in soil at 15 C, readily at 20–30 C (PNW). Soil moisture 15–25% (Illinois, international). Sources: [PNW](https://pnwhandbooks.org/node/2548); [Illinois RPD 203](http://ipm.illinois.edu/diseases/series200/rpd203/index.html)
required_inputs: Sowing date ; Field occurrence history over three to seven years

scientific_name: Fusarium verticillioides and other FFSC species
key_weather_variables: Hot, dry conditions at silking ; Preharvest wetness ; Grain moisture ; Insect wounds
thresholds_text: Above 25 C and preharvest wetness; fumonisin optimum about 24 C (international). Warm, slightly dry conditions (Korean source). Sources: [UT Crops](https://guide.utcrops.com/corn/corn-ear-rots/fusarium-ear-rot/); [Nongsaro](https://www.nongsaro.go.kr/portal/ps/pss/pssa/sicknsSearchDtl.ps?menuId=PS00202&sicknsCode=D00001173)
required_inputs: Silking date ; Harvest date ; Pest damage ; Cultivar and Bt status
evidence_summary: Anchor source-based; 14 days before silking inferred

key_weather_variables: Cool, wet conditions at silking ; Rainfall ; Autumn rain at harvest
thresholds_text: Silk susceptibility 2–6 days after emergence (CPN). Frequent rain during pistil formation (Korean source). Sources: [CPN](https://cropprotectionnetwork.org/encyclopedia/gibberella-ear-rot-of-corn); [Nongsaro document](http://www.nongsaro.go.kr/portal/ps/psb/psbk/kidoContentsFileDownload.ps?kidofcomdtyNo=29198)
required_inputs: Silking date ; Harvest date ; Cultivar

key_weather_variables: Mean monthly temperature in December, January and February
thresholds_text: Sum of three monthly means in F: below 80 negligible, 80–85 low, 85–90 moderate, above 90 severe (Iowa State). Low likelihood when December–February daily mean is below -3 C (EPPO). Sources: [Iowa State 2009](https://crops.extension.iastate.edu/cropnews/2009/04/2009-prediction-stewarts-disease-corn); [EPPO](https://gd.eppo.int/taxon/ERWIST/datasheet)
required_inputs: Region
evidence_summary: Winter window source-based; seedling window inferred

disease_en: Goss's bacterial wilt and leaf blight
key_weather_variables: Hail, strong wind and blowing sand ; Temperature
thresholds_text: About 27 C; possible suppression below 21 C or above 35 C (CPN, international). Sources: [CPN](https://cropprotectionnetwork.org/publications/an-overview-of-gosss-bacterial-wilt-and-blight)
required_inputs: Hail and strong-wind dates ; Sowing date ; Growth stage
evidence_summary: Leaf-blight window inferred; systemic window source-based

key_weather_variables: Nighttime temperature ; Water-film duration in darkness ; RH
thresholds_text: Nighttime 21–26 C, sporulation at 18–23 C, and a water film in darkness for at least 4–5 h (USDA CAPS, p.2; international). Sources: [USDA CAPS](https://caps.ceris.purdue.edu/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/Peronosclerospora-philippinensis-corn-manual-datasheet.pdf)
required_inputs: Sowing date ; Adjacent sugarcane and sorghum ; Seed origin

key_weather_variables: Leaf wetness ; Temperature ; Soil temperature ; Accumulated rainfall
thresholds_text: Sporangia at 22–25 C, 12 h leaf wetness, soil at 28–32 C; high annual rainfall of 100–200 cm (USDA CAPS, pp.1–2; international). Sources: [USDA CAPS](https://caps.ceris.purdue.edu/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/Sclerophthora-rayssiae-var-zeae-corn-manual-datasheet.pdf)
required_inputs: Sowing date

key_weather_variables: Consecutive drought/dry days ; Temperature as a vector-development proxy
thresholds_text: Temperature/humidity thresholds unconfirmed; drought exacerbates symptoms (Awata 2019, international). Sources: [Awata 2019](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC7753892/)
required_inputs: Sowing date ; Continuous cropping and nearby maize
